tema: The Antikythera mechanism, an ancient Greek computer
titulo: The 2,000-Year-Old Greek Computer That Shouldn't Exist
hook: In nineteen hundred, divers pulled a corroded lump from a shipwreck forty-five meters underwater, unaware they were holding a functional computer from two hundred BC.
descricao: In 1901, divers found a corroded lump off the coast of Greece that turned out to be an ancient analogue computer. How was such advanced technology completely lost for 1,500 years?

versoes.rascunho: In nineteen hundred, divers pulled a corroded lump from a shipwreck. It sat forgotten on a museum shelf for two full years. But what was hiding inside changed everything. On May seventeenth, nineteen two, archaeologist Valerios Stais looked closer. A piece of the crust cracked open. Embedded in the rock, he saw a precision gear wheel. The object came from a wreck forty-five meters underwater. For decades, scholars insisted it was impossible. Ancient humans lacked the tools for complex mechanics. Then, scientists ran the rock through high-resolution X-ray scans. They peered inside the corroded fragments. They discovered thirty meshing bronze gears. The device predicted eclipses decades in advance. It even calculated the irregular orbit of the Moon. It was a fully functional analogue computer from two hundred BC. Technology of this complexity vanished from Earth for fifteen hundred years. Nothing like it appeared again until fourteenth-century Western Europe. Who designed a computer two millennia before its time, and how was this knowledge lost? Tell me what you think in the comments.
